assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent PNG flying dragon sprite for a painted European fantasy board-game map. Create a single mature dragon seen from directly ABOVE and a little behind, so its BACK and the TOP SURFACES of both wings are clearly visible. It is fully airborne in a shallow banking glide, small head points to the upper left, long muscular tail curls toward the lower right, four compact legs tucked against the body, two swept batlike wings with a few broad scallops. A compact charcoal-plum body, muted dusty mauve and warm grey-brown leather wing membranes, short pale swept-back horns and small ridged spine. Distinct natural silhouette, no giant fantasy ornaments. Fine traditional gouache/colored-pencil painting with warm upper-left light and organic edges, restrained contrast and color, natural coherent anatomy. This sprite must still read as a flying dragon at only 70 pixels across. Center the entire creature, including every wingtip and tail tip, within generous 10-percent empty margins. Only ONE dragon. TRUE transparent alpha background everywhere outside it and between wings/limbs. No scenery, no sky, no clouds, no aura, NO glow or halo, no ground shadow, no border, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no text, no fire. Dragon paint itself opaque. Not a glossy 3D render, toy, cartoon, frontal portrait or underside view.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent PNG scenery sprite for a hand-painted fantasy board-game map. Subject: a rugged slate-grey mountain peak with a small russet-red dragon perched ON its summit. A coherent single compact mountain with one main summit and two lower rocky shoulders; subtly snow-dusted cool grey angular stone faces and a few muted mossy foothill rocks. The dragon is clearly a creature gripping the summit, head lifted looking to the right, wings partly folded in a compact raised V, one long tail draped and curled down the rock. Dragon is roughly one quarter of the total sprite height; the mountain is dominant, no oversized dragon covering it. Elevated three-quarter map perspective. Entire mountain and dragon completely visible with 10-percent transparent margin on every side. Match illustrated European fantasy board-game terrain, painted gouache with fine natural rocky brushwork, upper-left daylight, shaded blue-grey left folds and restrained warm grey highlights, subtle red/ochre dragon. Clean readable silhouette at 80 pixels high, enough contrast to see the perched dragon but integrated with rock. Uneven natural craggy base fades with a few small separated foothill stones, NO circular pedestal, no island/disk, no grass rectangle. Genuine transparent alpha around the sprite. No background, sky, clouds, fog, glow, heavy outline, cast ground shadow, scenery beyond this single peak, buildings, mine entrance, castle, text or border. Not photorealistic, glossy3D, or cartoon.
